posts.title: Using LLMs for Malware Analysis: What Works, What Fails, and How to Do It Safely
posts.description: A long, evidence-based guide to using LLMs in malware analysis as of November 2026: what the studies and practitioner reports show, where models fail, how malware now talks back to AI analysts, how to handle samples and data safely, and a workflow with tested code.

posts.title: An MCP Server Security Checklist for Authors (With the Real Bugs Behind Each Item)
posts.description: A long, practical security checklist for people who build MCP servers. Most items are tied to the MCP specification or to a real CVE or incident, with tested code, a test plan, and a prompt you can paste into your own agent.

posts.title: Your First Security Hire at an AI Startup: The First 90 Days, With Receipts
posts.description: A long, opinionated 90-day plan for the first security and compliance hire at an AI-native company. Built from real incidents, the 2026 breach data and the frameworks people actually use, with a worked threat model and a prompt you can paste into your own agent.
